item.source: web lookups on 2026-11-27 (stand-ins until a vendor quotes for the rePOWDER's own geometry): no vendor sells a factory BN-coated graphite crucible of this size, and AMAZEMET's spares have no public price or lead time (its configurator ends in a quote); a stock graphite bottom-pour crucible of about 200 mL with its sealing rod is $198 (MTI, mtixtl.com EQ-GR6083-LD), plain 220-250 mL crucibles $90-170 (MTI, Graphite Store, Indutherm): $200 each, coated in house (ZYP BN aerosol, $45 a can, about $1 a coat); stock items ship in 1-5 working days and graphite machined to print takes 7-12 days at one shop and 6-8 weeks at others (Ohio Carbon Blank, thermalprocessing.com, 2022): a 21-day median with a spread of 1.8, after BYU's purchase order. Rounds 1-5 assumed $450 and 49 days. Whether a third-party crucible fits the rePOWDER is unverified
